_note: Vibration + e-stim presets (our own designs). E-stim envelopes are slow and ramped: onsets ease in, rises stay <= 0.1 of the range per tick (<= 0.05 above half), falls may be instant. Vibration masks e-stim, so e-stim is never left to jump up the moment vibration stops.

presets.label: Tingle bed
presets.description: A steady tingle under a smooth 4 s vibration wave.

presets.label: Breath together
presets.description: Both breathe together every 10 s; the tingle follows a second behind.

presets.label: Counter-breath
presets.description: Vibration breathes in while the tingle breathes out, and the other way round.

presets.label: Heart accent
presets.description: A heartbeat, with a soft tingle swelling on every fourth beat.

presets.label: Split: pulse over tingle
presets.description: A steady tingle; vibration pulses once a second on top.

presets.label: Split: swell over hum
presets.description: A low steady hum; the tingle swells up over 6 s and eases back.

presets.label: Climb together
presets.description: Both step up a staircase; the tingle follows one step behind.

presets.label: Toggle
presets.description: Eight seconds of vibration, crossfade, eight seconds of tingle, crossfade back.

presets.label: Stroke + tingle
presets.description: Strokes at about 1.4 per second, with a tingle that rides along softly.

presets.label: Tide pair
presets.description: The tingle rises with each surge of the tide and drops away as it ebbs.

presets.label: Edge pair
presets.description: Both build for 30 s, the tingle peaks while the vibration hovers, then 15 s of complete stillness.

presets.label: Finale
presets.description: A three-minute arc: a slow start, quickening pulses, a full peak, then a long cool-down.
